findings.message: `FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', refresh_date) = '2026-09'` wraps the partition column `refresh_date` in FORMAT_DATE, so BigQuery can't use it to skip partitions of `proj.web.trends`; the query reads every partition (3.2 GB in all).
findings.fix: Compare `refresh_date` itself with a constant, for example `refresh_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
